##### Project general facts

Nawayef Heights presents an exceptional collection of luxury villas, each thoughtfully designed to embody elevated, refined living. The residences span a striking range of architectural styles, from sleek contemporary silhouettes to timeless Mediterranean-inspired facades, offering homes with five to seven bedrooms. Every villa is crafted with grand living spaces, private bedroom wings, and dedicated Majlis areas, creating an inviting haven for family life and gracious entertaining.

Life within Nawayef Heights is elevated by an outstanding array of private amenities designed for leisure and indulgence. Many villas boast their own infinity pools, sunken firepit lounges, and al fresco cabanas, alongside indulgent supercar garages and entertainment zones complete with games rooms and bars. Wellness is equally well catered for, with dedicated gyms, spas, and media rooms offering residents a genuine retreat within their own home.

Interiors throughout Nawayef Heights showcase an exquisite palette of natural stone, warm timber, and gleaming marble, resulting in spaces of remarkable elegance and serenity. Grand staircases, soaring atriums, and floor-to-ceiling glazing bring in abundant natural light while celebrating the beauty of open, flowing design. Every detail, from bespoke joinery to sculptural lighting and premium fittings, reflects a genuine commitment to craftsmanship and enduring luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Hudayriyat Island, this exceptional location is a destination shaped by duality - where energy and calm, urbanity and sanctuary, discovery and accessibility exist in seamless balance. Set against pristine waters and open skies, the island brings together leisure, sport, wellness, and community in one iconic setting, designed for life to move in a natural state of flow.

The location is distinguished by its effortless connectivity and world-class surroundings. Zayed International Airport, Abu Dhabi Global Market, the Louvre Museum, and Yas Island’s attractions are all within a short drive. The island itself offers a vibrant coastal environment with mangroves, beaches, and cycling trails, while nearby landmarks include the Velodrome, Surf Abu Dhabi, and the High Performance Centre.

For those seeking a residence that embodies prestige, tranquility, and investment potential, Hudayriyat Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of championship golf, waterfront living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address makes it one of the emirate’s most desirable locations. This is a place where life finds its swing — grounded, boundless and effortlessly connected.
